properties.name: stratum.http-client.enabled
properties.description: Whether the HTTP client module is on. With false, Stratum finds no @StratumClient interface and sets up nothing, and Spring Boot's clients keep Spring Boot's own defaults.

properties.name: stratum.http-client.defaults.retries
properties.description: Removed: how many times a failed call is sent again. Use retry.max-retries.

deprecation.reason: The retry settings moved into the retry group (ADR 0013).

properties.name: stratum.http-client.defaults.retry-delay
properties.description: Removed: the wait before the first retry. Use retry.delay.

deprecation.reason: The retry settings moved into the retry group (ADR 0013).

properties.name: stratum.http-client.defaults.circuit-breaker
properties.description: Removed: whether the client has a circuit breaker. Use circuit-breaker.enabled.

deprecation.reason: The circuit breaker settings moved into the circuit-breaker group (ADR 0013).
